messages:
maya: quick note from customer sync — they want a small, opinionated Optimize MVP we can ship as a playbook + SDK. priority features: batching heuristics, prefix/KV cache guidance, a conservative quant path, and eval-triggered alerts.
ryan: agree on small scope. propose MVP vs GA gates?
anita: MVP = single pilot customer + docs + acceptance tests. GA = multiple pilots, console integration, auto-fallbacks.
maya: MVP acceptance checks I propose:
- p95 latency on target distribution <= 150ms with batching enabled
- >=15% cost improvement on batch-heavy workloads vs baseline
- quantized model accuracy loss <= 1% measured on customer eval
- eval-triggered alerts in dry-run + slack notify
ben: need to be explicit about "target distribution" for the latency metric — short user prompts: 8-64 tokens, context cold/warm states noted.
ryan: quant approach — recommend INT8 dynamic for MVP (low-risk). 4-bit can be an internal alpha, not required for MVP.
anita: caching guidance: two patterns — prefix (static system prompts) and session KV reuse. SDK should expose toggles and a small telemetry surface.
maya: telemetry required: per-route cache-hit-rate, p95 latency delta, and cost delta. must be shipped for pilot to validate wins.
ben: alerts — daily eval job + realtime drift heuristics. sample rule: if concordance drops by >2% OR avg token logprob shifts by >0.15 => notification + rollback candidate. dry-run first.
ryan: example alert config (as text):
```
job: daily-optimize-eval
rules:
  - metric: concordance_pct_delta
    threshold: -2
    action: slack-only-dryrun
  - metric: avg_token_logprob_shift
    threshold: 0.15
    action: failover-to-pinned
```
anita: rollout plan: 1) internal alpha with two models 2) red-team pilot with 1 customer 3) open beta. each step needs checklists.
ben: top engineering priorities: SDK toggles + telemetry events. we can't measure impact without them.
maya: agreed — MVP minimal scope = SDK toggles (batch, cache, quant), telemetry, eval job + dry-run alerts, short playbook docs, and a single dashboard tile in console.
ryan: infra deps: runtime batching knobs (eng-runtime), cache infra + shared KV (eng-infra), telemetry ingest (eng-platform). I'll add owners.
anita: customer acceptance for pilot — their eval suite must show concordance delta <=1% and p95 <=150ms. fallback plan: manual rollback within 10 minutes for pilot traffic, auto fallback to pinned float model is GA-level.
ben: note — include a noisy-alert gating: alert dry-run for 7 days before any paging.
maya: actions: anita draft playbook + acceptance checklist (due EOD tomorrow); ryan scope runtime changes (2 days); ben instrument telemetry + SDK toggles (3 days); maya onboard pilot (3 days). reconvene after drafts. :tada:
devops-bot: deployment scheduled: optimize-playbook-alpha -> staging on 2024-11-06T03:00Z. will ping #eng-releases.
